w10_T4_004639: A stationery warehouse had 112 boxes of pencils, and a returned order added 22 boxes. Each box was opened into 4 packs, and every pack held 8 pencils. A school then donated 78 loose pencils to the same store. The warehouse stands 300 metres from the station. How many pencils are in the store?
w10_T4_004641: On Monday morning Rosa had 236 rolls of wire in her workshop, more than her colleague Timo had. She bought 13 rolls before lunch, and Timo gave her 54 in the early afternoon. In the evening the supplier cut every roll she owned into 9 lengths. A late delivery added 51 lengths, and half of her workshop is taken up by the bender. How many lengths does Rosa have?
w10_T4_004642: A sweet shop had 92 packs of marshmallows, and each pack held 9 marshmallows. A supplier sent 48 loose marshmallows, a school fair donated 43, and a bakery added 30. A neighbour brought 24 more. Half of the shop's shelving is given over to jars, and the shop sells 60 varieties in all. How many marshmallows does the shop have?
w10_T4_004644: Meera weaves more baskets than her cousin Anil does. She cut 101 bundles of willow, and each bundle produced 7 rods. Every rod was then split into 8 strands. Anil gave her 80 strands, and a supplier sent 11 more. The workshop is 25 years old. How many strands does Meera have?
w10_T4_004649: A hospital ward had 30 wheelchairs. A charity donated 41 chairs, 2 chairs were scrapped, and a hire firm added 5. The trust then matched the ward's stock exactly, leaving it with 2 chairs for every chair it had. Over the year 141 chairs were transferred to other hospitals, and a clinic that closed sent 50 chairs across. The ward has 24 beds. How many wheelchairs does the ward have now?
w10_T4_004651: Tobias runs a bigger bike-hire fleet than his neighbour Greta does. He started the season with 192 bikes, and 97 were hired out for the summer. A flood damaged 52 bikes beyond repair. Greta lent him 27 bikes, and a school trip then took 58 away for a week. Half of his yard is given over to repairs. How many bikes are left in Tobias's yard?
w10_T4_004657: Elin paints more signs than her apprentice Rui does. She had 63 blank boards, and the supplier delivered 2 boards for every board she already owned. She spoiled 14 boards on a windy day, and 9 were sold unpainted. Rui then gave her 11 boards from his own store. How many boards does Elin have?
w10_T4_004661: A maple farm had 60 barrels of sap, and the taps filled 3 barrels for every barrel already in the shed. A tanker took 68 barrels away. Each barrel still on the farm was boiled down into 8 jugs, and every jug was decanted into 4 bottles. A supermarket then bought 2772 bottles. The farm has 45 tapped trees to the acre, and it lists its syrup in litres although the bottles are marked in millilitres. How many bottles are left?
w10_T4_004664: Sara has more gift vouchers to hand out than her colleague Dev does. She started with 197 vouchers, and 97 were given to customers. The rest were shared equally between the 4 branches, and the station branch's pile is the one being followed. Then 4 vouchers in that pile expired. Dev added 63 vouchers to the same pile, and a promotion used up 79 of them. The vouchers are valued in dollars although the till records them in cents. How many vouchers are in the station branch's pile?
w10_T4_004665: Yuki folds more paper cranes than her classmate Haru does. She had 159 sheets of paper, and a teacher gave her 3 more. Each sheet was cut into 5 squares, and every square was then halved into 2 smaller squares. From each small square Yuki folded 7 tiny cranes. Haru added 29 cranes he had folded, and a visitor contributed 25 more. How many cranes are there now?
w10_T4_004667: A hospital laundry had 71 rolls of paper towel, and a supplier delivered 63 more. Each roll was cut into 9 packs. A ward then took 496 packs. The trust ordered 4 packs for every pack still in the store. Half of the store is refrigerated, and the trust bills its supplies in dollars although the invoices are itemised in cents. How many packs does the order come to?
w10_T4_004669: A match factory filled 29 cases, and each case held 8 cartons. Every carton contained 6 boxes of matches. A shop bought 455 boxes. The factory then produced 2 boxes for every box it had left, and a second run made 7 boxes for each of those. The plant employs 40 people, and it measures its timber in metres although the invoices are written in centimetres. How many boxes does the factory have now?
w10_T4_004672: Kasper has more deck chairs than his cousin Bea does. He started the season with 224 chairs, and a hotel sold him 39 more. Bea lent him 6 chairs. Storms then wrecked 202 chairs over the winter. The council matched what he had left, leaving him 2 chairs for every chair he owned. Hire is charged in hours although the tickets are printed in minutes. How many deck chairs does Kasper have now?
w10_T4_004676: A tea room ordered 228 boxes of biscuits, and a supplier added 34 boxes. Each box was opened into 6 packets, and every packet held 7 biscuits. A neighbour then brought 44 loose biscuits. The tea room lists its opening times in hours although the staff clock in by the minute. How many biscuits does the tea room have?
w10_T4_004677: On Monday morning a bolt works cut 163 bars of steel, and each bar made 4 rods. Before noon every rod was threaded into 5 bolts. In the early afternoon a returned order added 46 bolts. Later the plant produced 8 bolts for every bolt in the store. In the evening a supplier sent 8 bolts, and a workshop returned 55 more. The works quotes machine times in minutes although the plans are written in hours. How many bolts are in the store?
w10_T4_004681: A hotel had 49 umbrellas in its stand. Guests took 43 umbrellas away over the summer, and 1 was broken in a gale. A lost-property sale then added 79 umbrellas, and a coach party took 59 of them. Half of the stand is empty now, and the hotel has 120 rooms. How many umbrellas are in the stand?
w10_T4_004682: A shoe factory received 167 hides, and each hide was cut into 5 panels. Every panel was then cut into 7 pieces, and each piece was stitched with 4 eyelets. A supplier sent 29 spare eyelets. The factory has 90 sewing stations. How many eyelets are there in total?
w10_T4_004685: On Monday morning a chocolate factory took in 226 sacks of cocoa, and each sack filled 9 vats. By noon every vat had been poured into 8 moulds. In the early afternoon each mould was cut into 6 bars, and a returned order added 80 bars. In the evening every bar was broken into 8 squares. Overnight a taster's box added 5 squares to the count. How many squares does the factory have?
w10_T4_004686: A scaffolding yard had 70 poles, and a hire return left it with 2 poles for every pole in the racks. Each pole was then cut into 4 shorter sections. A building site took 339 sections away. The yard then ordered 6 sections for every section it had left. The yard measures its steel in metres although the invoices are written in millimetres. How many sections does that order come to?
w10_T4_004688: On Tuesday morning a toy factory moulded 197 trays, and each tray held 8 figures. By the afternoon every figure had been packed with 5 accessories. In the evening a supplier sent 18 accessories, and a returned order added 47 more. Half of the factory floor is used for storage, and the firm employs 210 people. How many accessories are there now?
w10_T4_004690: A cable maker had 69 drums of wire, and each drum was wound into 9 coils. A contractor bought 115 coils. Every coil still in the works was then cut into 6 leads. A factory order took 444 leads, a returned batch added 75, and a shop sent back 61 more. The maker measures its cable in metres although the labels are printed in centimetres. How many leads does the maker have?
w10_T4_004692: Nora runs a bigger crockery hire than her colleague Piet does. She had 88 stacks of plates, and a caterer sold her 65 more. The stacks were shared equally between the 3 vans, and the city van is the one being followed. Each stack in that van was then unpacked into 5 plates. A wedding broke 172 of those plates, and Piet lent her 24 plates. How many plates does the city van have?
w10_T4_004696: A first-aid charity had 94 kits in its store. A grant paid for 75 kits, a supplier donated 26, and a school returned 20. During the summer events 59 kits were used up. Half of the store is kept for training dummies, and the charity plans its courses in hours although the registers are marked in minutes. How many kits are in the store?
w10_T4_004697: A sign-writer had 62 rolls of vinyl, and a supplier sent 21 more. A shopfront job used up 26 rolls, and 19 rolls were spoiled by the heat. A festival contract then tripled the number of rolls he held. Each roll was cut into 9 letters, and a colleague gave him 13 spare letters. The workshop has 5 plotters. How many letters does the sign-writer have?
w10_T4_004706: On Monday morning a nail factory had 150 coils of wire, and a delivery added 65 more. Before noon each coil was cut into 8 blanks. During the afternoon 677 blanks failed the head test and were scrapped. In the early evening the plant made 4 nails from every blank it had left, and a supplier added 39 nails to the bin. Overnight head office ordered that whole bin again for each of 9 depots, needing that many nails per depot. How many nails does the whole order come to?
